```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Setup

### Load libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(posterior)
library(bayestestR)
library(loo)
library(bayesplot)
library(here)
```

### Import imputed dfs

```{r import-data}
analytic_dfs <- readRDS(here("Imputed Data", "analytic_dfs.rds"))
analytic_dfs_y <- readRDS(here("Imputed Data", "analytic_dfs_y.rds"))
```

### Initial checks

```{r initial-checks}
length(analytic_dfs)
sapply(analytic_dfs, nrow) |> unique()
colnames(analytic_dfs[[1]])

length(analytic_dfs_y)
sapply(analytic_dfs_y, nrow) |> unique()
colnames(analytic_dfs_y[[1]])
```

### Create folders

```{r folders}
dir.create(here("Supplementary Models"), showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 1. ADHD traits analysis

## Set up formulas and prior

```{r traits-hypothesis-formulas-prior}
# Formulas
formula_h1_traits <- bf(ers_total_s ~ pds_total_s * swan_total_s
                        + age_cont_s + sed_percentile_s)

formula_h2_traits <- bf(ers_total_s ~ pubertal_timing_s * swan_total_s 
                        + sed_percentile_s)

formula_h1_traits_nointeract <- bf(ers_total_s ~ pds_total_s + swan_total_s
                                   + age_cont_s + sed_percentile_s)

formula_h2_traits_nointeract <- bf(ers_total_s ~ pubertal_timing_s + swan_total_s 
                                   + sed_percentile_s)

# Specify priors
priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sigma")
)
```

### Check default prior

```{r traits-default-prior}
get_prior(
  formula = formula_h1_traits,
  data = analytic_dfs[[1]],
  family = gaussian()
)

get_prior(
  formula = formula_h2_traits,
  data = analytic_dfs[[1]],
  family = gaussian()
)
```

## Run models

### H1 Traits Model

```{r H1-traits-model}
fit_h1_traits <- brm_multiple(
  formula = formula_h1_traits,
  data = analytic_dfs,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = priors,   
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  cores = 4,   
  seed = 12345
)

saveRDS(fit_h1_traits, here("Supplementary Models", "fit_h1_traits.rds"))
```

### H1 Traits Model output

```{r H1-traits-summary}
bayes_R2(fit_h1_traits)

# Compute pd and ROPE
effect_h1_traits <- describe_posterior(
  fit_h1_traits,
  effects = "all",
  test = c("pd", "rope"),
  rope_range = c(-0.1, 0.1),
  rope_ci = 1,
  centrality = c("mean", "median"),
  ci = 0.95,
  ci_method = "hdi"
)

# Flag meaningful effects
effect_h1_traits <- effect_h1_traits %>%
  mutate(meaningful = pd > 0.95 & ROPE_Percentage < 0.05)

# Result summary
effect_h1_traits %>%
  select(Parameter, Mean, Median, CI_low, CI_high, pd, ROPE_Percentage, meaningful)
```

### H1 Traits Model diagnostics and PP checks

```{r H1-traits-diagnostics}
cat("=== Rhat and ESS ===\n")
cat("Rhat values close to 1 indicate convergence. ESS should ideally be > 400.\n\n")
as_draws_df(fit_h1_traits) %>% summarise_draws(default_convergence_measures())

cat("\n=== Divergent Transitions ===\n")
cat("Ideally 0. Large numbers indicate sampler problems.\n\n")
cat("Number of divergent transitions:", 
    sum(nuts_params(fit_h1_traits)$Parameter == "divergent__" &
          nuts_params(fit_h1_traits)$Value == 1),
    "\n")

# Trace plots
cat("\n=== Trace Plots ===\n")
mcmc_trace(fit_h1_traits, regex_pars = "^b_") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Prior Summary
cat("\n=== Prior Summary ===\n")
cat("Priors specified for the model.\n\n")
prior_summary(fit_h1_traits)

# Posterior Predictive Checks
cat("\n=== Posterior Predictive Checks ===\n")
cat("Density plots for each parameter.\n\n")
plot(fit_h1_traits, ask = FALSE)

cat("\n=== PPC: Density Overlay ===\n")
cat("y_rep lines should closely follow the observed y distribution.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h1_traits, ndraws = 100)

cat("\n=== PPC: Error Histogram ===\n")
cat("Errors should be approximately normally distributed around 0.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h1_traits, type = "error_hist")

cat("\n=== PPC: Mean ===\n")
cat("Observed mean (dark line) should fall within the distribution of replicated means.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h1_traits, type = "stat", stat = "mean")

cat("\n=== PPC: Median ===\n")
cat("Observed median (dark line) should fall within the distribution of replicated medians.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h1_traits, type = "stat", stat = "median")

cat("\n=== PPC: SD ===\n")
cat("Observed SD (dark line) should fall within the distribution of replicated SDs.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h1_traits, type = "stat", stat = "sd")

cat("\n=== PPC: Scatter Average ===\n")
cat("Points should cluster around the diagonal. Systematic patterns indicate misfit.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h1_traits, type = "scatter_avg")

# Pareto-k
cat("\n=== Pareto-k ===\n")
loo_h1_traits <- loo(fit_h1_traits)
pareto_k_table(loo_h1_traits)
plot(loo_h1_traits, label_points = TRUE)
```

### H1 Traits Model no interaction

```{r H1-traits-nointeract-model}
fit_h1_traits_nointeract <- brm_multiple(
  formula = formula_h1_traits_nointeract,
  data = analytic_dfs,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = priors,   
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  cores = 4,   
  seed = 12345
)

saveRDS(fit_h1_traits_nointeract, here("Supplementary Models", "fit_h1_traits_nointeract.rds"))
```

### H1 Traits Model no interaction output

```{r H1-traits-nointeract-summary}
bayes_R2(fit_h1_traits_nointeract)

# Compute pd and ROPE
effect_h1_traits_nointeract <- describe_posterior(
  fit_h1_traits_nointeract,
  effects = "all",
  test = c("pd", "rope"),
  rope_range = c(-0.1, 0.1),
  rope_ci = 1,
  centrality = c("mean", "median"),
  ci = 0.95,
  ci_method = "hdi"
)

# Flag meaningful effects
effect_h1_traits_nointeract <- effect_h1_traits_nointeract %>%
  mutate(meaningful = pd > 0.95 & ROPE_Percentage < 0.05)

# Result summary
effect_h1_traits_nointeract %>%
  select(Parameter, Mean, Median, CI_low, CI_high, pd, ROPE_Percentage, meaningful)

# Pubertal status and ADHD traits effects in raw units
cat("=== Pubertal status and ADHD traits effects in raw outcome units ===\n")

# Extract SD of each raw variable from each imputed dataset, then average across imputations
sd_ers_raw  <- map_dbl(analytic_dfs, ~ sd(.x$ers_total, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% mean()
sd_pds_raw  <- map_dbl(analytic_dfs, ~ sd(.x$pds_total, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% mean()
sd_swan_raw <- map_dbl(analytic_dfs, ~ sd(.x$swan_total, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% mean()

draws <- as_draws_df(fit_h1_traits_nointeract)

raw_effects_traits <- draws %>%
  transmute(
    pds_raw_effect  = b_pds_total_s  * (sd_ers_raw / sd_pds_raw),
    swan_raw_effect = b_swan_total_s * (sd_ers_raw / sd_swan_raw)
  )

raw_effects_traits %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "effect", values_to = "draw") %>%
  group_by(effect) %>%
  summarise(
    mean  = mean(draw),
    lower = bayestestR::hdi(draw, ci = 0.95)$CI_low,
    upper = bayestestR::hdi(draw, ci = 0.95)$CI_high,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

## 2. Menarche analysis

## Set up formulas

```{r hypothesis-formulas-prior}
# Formulas
formula_h1_menarche <- bf(ers_total_s ~ menarche_status * adhd_status
                          + age_cont_s + sed_percentile_s)

formula_h2_menarche <- bf(ers_total_s ~ menarche_timing_s * adhd_status 
                          + sed_percentile_s)

formula_h1_menarche_nointeract <- bf(ers_total_s ~ menarche_status + adhd_status
                                     + age_cont_s + sed_percentile_s)

formula_h2_menarche_nointeract <- bf(ers_total_s ~ menarche_timing_s + adhd_status
                                     + sed_percentile_s)

```

```{r default-prior}
)
```

```{r H1-menarche-nointeract-output}
)

raw_effects_menarche %>%
```

## 3. Young person data models

## Set up formulas

```{r yp-hypothesis-formulas-prior}
# Formulas
formula_h1_y <- bf(ers_total_y_s ~ pds_total_y_s * adhd_y 
                 + age_cont_y_s + sed_percentile_s)

formula_h2_y <- bf(ers_total_y_s ~ pubertal_timing_y_s * adhd_y 
                 + sed_percentile_s)

formula_h1_y_nointeract <- bf(ers_total_y_s ~ pds_total_y_s + adhd_y
                              + age_cont_y_s + sed_percentile_s)

formula_h2_y_nointeract <- bf(ers_total_y_s ~ pubertal_timing_y_s + adhd_y
                              + sed_percentile_s)
```

### Check default prior

```{r y-default-prior}
get_prior(

  data = analytic_dfs_y[[1]],
  family = gaussian()
)

get_prior(

  data = analytic_dfs_y[[1]],
  family = gaussian()
)
```

```{r H2-y-diagnostics}
    sum(nuts_params(fit_h2_y)$Parameter == "divergent__" &
          nuts_params(fit_h2_y)$Value == 1),
    "\n")

# Trace plots
cat("\n=== Trace Plots ===\n")
mcmc_trace(fit_h2_y, regex_pars = "^b_") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Prior Summary
cat("\n=== Prior Summary ===\n")
cat("Priors specified for the model.\n\n")
prior_summary(fit_h2_y)

# Posterior Predictive Checks
cat("\n=== Posterior Predictive Checks ===\n")
cat("Density plots for each parameter.\n\n")
plot(fit_h2_y, ask = FALSE)

cat("\n=== PPC: Density Overlay ===\n")
cat("y_rep lines should closely follow the observed y distribution.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h2_y, ndraws = 100)

cat("\n=== PPC: Error Histogram ===\n")
cat("Errors should be approximately normally distributed around 0.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h2_y, type = "error_hist")

cat("\n=== PPC: Mean ===\n")
cat("Observed mean (dark line) should fall within the distribution of replicated means.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h2_y, type = "stat", stat = "mean")

cat("\n=== PPC: Median ===\n")
cat("Observed median (dark line) should fall within the distribution of replicated medians.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h2_y, type = "stat", stat = "median")

cat("\n=== PPC: SD ===\n")
cat("Observed SD (dark line) should fall within the distribution of replicated SDs.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h2_y, type = "stat", stat = "sd")

cat("\n=== PPC: Scatter Average ===\n")
cat("Points should cluster around the diagonal. Systematic patterns indicate misfit.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h2_y, type = "scatter_avg")

# Pareto-k
cat("\n=== Pareto-k ===\n")
loo_h2_y <- loo(fit_h2_y)
pareto_k_table(loo_h2_y)
plot(loo_h2_y, label_points = TRUE)
```

### H2 Young Person Model no interaction 

```{r H2-y-nointeract-model}
fit_h2_y_nointeract <- brm_multiple(
  formula = formula_h2_y_nointeract,
  data = analytic_dfs_y,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = priors,   
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  cores = 4,   
  seed = 12345
)

saveRDS(fit_h2_y_nointeract, here("Supplementary Models", "fit_h2_y_nointeract.rds"))
```

### H2 Young Person Model no interaction output

```{r H2-y-nointeract-output}
bayes_R2(fit_h2_y_nointeract)

# Compute pd and ROPE
effect_h2_y_nointeract <- describe_posterior(
  fit_h2_y_nointeract,
  effects = "all",
  test = c("pd", "rope"),
  rope_range = c(-0.1, 0.1),
  rope_ci = 1,
  centrality = c("mean", "median"),
  ci = 0.95,
  ci_method = "hdi"
)

# Flag meaningful effects
effect_h2_y_nointeract <- effect_h2_y_nointeract %>%
  mutate(meaningful = pd > 0.95 & ROPE_Percentage < 0.05)

# Result summary
effect_h2_y_nointeract %>%
  select(Parameter, Mean, Median, CI_low, CI_high, pd, ROPE_Percentage, meaningful)

# ADHD difference in raw outcome units
cat("=== ADHD difference in raw outcome units ===\n")

# Extract SD of each raw variable from each imputed dataset, then average across imputations
sd_ers_raw_y <- map_dbl(analytic_dfs_y, ~ sd(.x$ers_total_y, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% mean()

draws <- as_draws_df(fit_h2_y_nointeract)

raw_effects_y_2 <- draws %>%
  transmute(
    adhd_raw_effect_y = b_adhd_yY * sd_ers_raw_y
  )

hdi_adhd_y <- bayestestR::hdi(raw_effects_y_2$adhd_raw_effect_y, ci = 0.95)

tibble(
  adhd_raw_effect_y_mean  = mean(raw_effects_y_2$adhd_raw_effect_y),
  adhd_raw_effect_y_lower = hdi_adhd_y$CI_low,
  adhd_raw_effect_y_upper = hdi_adhd_y$CI_high
) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```
